notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection covers title and favicon only; description and preview image are missing.
REF-BM-03: The title is editable before and after saving, but descriptions are unsupported.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and note are editable, but description is unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are detected, but the dialog permits saving another copy and does not converge to editing the existing bookmark.
REF-BM-07: List cards expose title, tags, and favicon, but no description.
REF-BM-10: Existing tags are displayed as checkboxes; there is no tag-entry autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search indexes title, URL, and tags, but not note or description.
REF-BM-14: Search does not parse #tag syntax; the literal hash prevents the intended tag match.
REF-BM-15: The entire query is escaped as one phrase, so boolean operators and parenthesised groups are not evaluated.
REF-BM-16: User-supplied quoted phrases are escaped as literal quote characters rather than parsed as exact-phrase syntax.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: No mark-as-read operation exists.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions exist.
REF-BM-21: No current-filter whole-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but they are rendered as plain text rather than Markdown.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot facility exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-26: No bookmark archive state or operation exists.
REF-BM-27: Permanent deletion exists, but there is no reversible archive operation to distinguish from it.
REF-BM-28: No archived-only list exists.
REF-BM-29: No dynamic saved-filter bundle entity or workflow exists.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import exists.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export exists.
REF-BM-32: No persisted personal display settings exist.
